Official BCAC page provides the Zhang et al. 2020 overall-breast-cancer results for women of European ancestry and links this public Drive file. The official data dictionary defines GRCh37 var_name and rsid:position:non-effect:effect tags; the source-specific materializer retains only autosomal tags explicitly carrying an rsID that agree with documented GRCh37 coordinates and meta-analysis alleles. Meta beta is log(OR), sdE.meta is its SE, and p.meta is used. The source audit records one repeated-header fragment, one incomplete record, and 235914 non-autosomal rows (including 4 chromosome-X allele conflicts); all are excluded while any autosomal conflict fails. No upstream checksum was supplied; the complete, range-validated 4,764,280,363-byte archive has local SHA-256 recorded here. The trait registry cites an explicit 13.0% US female lifetime-risk approximation for liability conversion.

GCST009325 is the European public analysis combining 15,056 diagnosed cases, 18,618 UKB proxy cases, and 449,056 controls; unlike GCST009324, it includes the proxy stratum selected for the atlas. The paper's data-access statement says this public release excludes the restricted Nalls 2014, post-Chang 23andMe, and PDWBS components. Complete streaming validation reproduced 959,357,456 bytes, counted 17,510,617 literal data rows, and produced the registered SHA-256; Catalog MD5 88c9f0d63ebeda700396d4402d8adf03 is supplied upstream. The Catalog metadata declares GRCh37. Its harmonizer processed 17,506,012 sites and added rsIDs only in a GRCh38 companion, so the raw hg19 file still requires a documented coordinate-and-allele-to-rsID mapping.

OpenGWAS dataset ieu-b-38 is the public LD Hub/OpenGWAS copy of the exact Evangelou 2018 UKB+ICBP European SBP meta-analysis (N up to 757,601), not a substitute phenotype. The stable public endpoint is POSTed with the registered dataset ID and returns a rate-limited short-lived VCF URL; the source-specific downloader never stores that expiring URL. A complete 216,210,855-byte download produced the registered SHA-256 and MD5 5716e0faaab6e4248560fb775d8de93a and passed a multi-member gzip integrity test. GWAS-VCF metadata declares HG19/GRCh37 and 7,088,083 harmonized variants with none unread or unharmonized; rs3094315 is at GRCh37 1:752566. FORMAT/ES is the effect per ALT allele in mmHg, FORMAT/SE its SE, FORMAT/LP is -log10(P), FORMAT/AF is ALT frequency, and FORMAT/SS is per-variant sample size. The materializer floors only P values below 1e-300 so downstream floating-point parsing cannot underflow silently.

GCST90132314 is the exact primary discovery meta-analysis with 181,522 cases and 984,168 controls; GCST90132315 is the distinct cross-ancestry extension with Biobank Japan and is deliberately excluded. The primary paper says participants were more than 95% European, but the official Catalog metadata explicitly labels the 1,165,690-person source European plus ancestry not reported, so this record is not relabelled strictly EUR and cannot pass the atlas EUR-only harmonization gate without a reviewed policy decision. The official README defines the 22-column pre-GWAS-SSF schema, fixed-effect inverse-variance meta-analysis, per-effect-allele beta/OR, GRCh37 positions, and per-variant cases/effective_cases/n. An earlier complete branch download reproduced 3,250,443,774 bytes, generated the registered SHA-256, and validated nine GRCh37 allele-coordinate anchors; current EBI HEAD/range checks reproduce the exact byte count, header, terminal rows, and official MD5 92bc58de063ebbf34c4ee39adbdaf798. The 20,073,070-row release has coordinate-and-allele markername values rather than rsIDs and requires an audited mapping before LDSC.
